inputs.original_text: Earlier this month, an Indiana judge blocked a prolife law, arguing that limiting abortion violates freedom of religion. The claim, brought by the American Civil Liberties Union and Hoosier Jews for Choice, argued that an Indiana law “violates religious freedoms by burdening the ability to obtain an abortion in accordance with their sincerely held beliefs.” Judge Christina R. [...] The post This Judge Thinks Killing Babies in Abortions is a Religious Right appeared first on LifeNews.com .
inputs.modified_text: Earlier this month, an Indiana judge blocked a prolife law after the ACLU and Hoosier Jews for Choice argued that it burdened religious freedom by limiting access to abortion. The message calls this an inversion: a principle meant to protect belief is being used to weaken abortion limits, presented in neutral legal language. It says LifeNews’s headline signals which side it believes is benefiting, while the framing itself is part of the contest over who gets to define religious freedom.
